name: Connector changing wire identity
aliases: Connector changing wire identity IEC reference
summary: This form identifies a connector representation that allows wire-number identities to change across the interface.
description: This form identifies a connector representation that allows wire-number identities to change across the interface. The two sides retain their separate wire identifiers while the connector pin mapping shows how they connect. That numbering rule does not create a conversion or an isolated electrical function.
Record both wire labels at the correct pin identities. The mating connector relationship is the evidence of continuity across the numbering change.
readingNotes: Keep both wire identifiers tied to the correct mating pins.
A change in wire number does not by itself indicate electrical isolation, conversion or a change in voltage.
